The '''MSP80 Pteropter''' (or '''Pteroptor''') '''hover pod''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] model used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] to hunt their prey as sport during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:TrandoshanHuntingSpeeder.png|thumb|left|180px|A hoverpod preparing to lift off]]
The MSP80 had a rotary [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|repeating blaster cannon]] and three landing legs that folded up during take-off. The speeder was open in the back, with no safeguards.<ref name="PL" />

==History==
During the [[attack on Kashyyyk]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] used hover pods to quickly attack [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. The [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] were usually parked on the landing platform of the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|floating fortress]].  [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] and the crew of the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Star Runner]]'', upon crashing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], encountered a group of Trandoshans on hover pods who [[Rebellion on Felucia|attacked]] them.<ref name="Kinect" />

When the hunting games began, three Trandoshans got on each speeder, flew into the jungle and started searching for their prey.<ref name="PL" /> One of these vehicles was hijacked by a group of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] that had survived multiple hunts; after capturing [[Smug/Legends|Smug]], a Trandoshan guard/sniper, they [[Mind trick/Legends|mind-tricked]] him to call his comrade [[Krix/Legends|Krix]] and ask for transportation. Krix arrived only to find that he had stepped into a trap. The Padawans knocked him and Smug unconscious and took the vehicle.<ref name="WH">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>
